findings.message: Entry params listaId, responsavelId, prioridade, status, prazoDe, prazoAte, venceHoje and atrasada filter tarefasEquipe but no state holds them. Added persisted public states with the param names, filled from URL/localStorage on entry, plus filtrarTarefasEquipe(filtro) and limparFiltrosTarefasEquipe() that publish them and reload from page 1.

Command reatribuirTarefa has no <command>.input state although the manager must pick the new assignee. Added reatribuirTarefaDraft (ReatribuirTarefaDraft) with setReatribuirTarefaDraft; id and version are taken from the selected tarefa at submit.

reatribuirTarefa and cancelarTarefa return a TarefaDetalhe, but the board rows are TarefaEquipeItem. The row is patched with the shared fields (titulo, status, prioridade, prazo, responsavel, progressoChecklist) and removed when it no longer matches the status, assignee or due-today/overdue filters. The venceHoje/atrasada indicators of rows that stay open and the ordering of the list are only refreshed on the next listarTarefasEquipe call.
The historicoTarefa timeline has no reassignment events in the contract output (only the milestones of TarefaDetalhe); nothing was invented for it.
